definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Agroforestry Districts.

t: 2030 — First district hulls products reach price parity: tree alleys cu
title: 2030 — First district hulls products reach price parity: tree alleys cu
definition: 2030 milestone on the Agroforestry Districts roadmap.
description:
First district hulls products reach price parity: tree alleys cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the tree alleys results have to replicate outside the lab, district logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and shade planning operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed tree alleys demonstrations, district logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting shade planning uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Agroforestry Districts readiness from component maturity.

Honest scoring is the point: a district hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Agroforestry Districts Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Agroforestry Districts operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Agroforestry Districts installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 91264 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where tree alleys monitoring, district logistics redundancy, or shade planning maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Agroforestry Districts Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Agroforestry Districts: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Agroforestry Districts — districts mixing trees and crops.

Phase 1 — Prove (tree alleys): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (district logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (shade planning): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (diverse income): district hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and farms-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
